newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney mutual fund manager leaves - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney mutual fund manager leaves - WSJ.

text.p: Jessica Bibliowicz, the head of Smith Barney Inc's mutual funds, is stepping down to become president of money manager John Levin & Co, the Wall Street Journal said in Monday's electronic edition.
A surprising aspect of the move is that Bibliowicz is the daughter of Sanford Weill, the chairman of Smith Barney's parent, Travelers Group Inc.

The Journal said Bibliowicz was leaving in part because her drive to move up in the ranks may be stymied by the presence of Chairman James Dimon, who is close to her father and is equally as ambitious.
